'''Jono''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who was at one point a lover of [[Kaliyo Djannis]]. Years later she commented to [[Cipher Nine]] that he used to have a great body and warned not to mess with her like Jono did.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jono is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission.
